patthana23.58:3.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.

patthana23.58:5.1: sahajātavārampi paccayavārampi saṃsaṭṭhavārampi sampayuttavārampi pañhāvārampi vitthāretabbaṃ. paccanīyānuloma tikattikapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. paccanīyānulomadukadukapaṭṭhānaṃ nahetuduka nasahetukaduke hetuduka sahetukadukaṃ
